description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class EmployeeOnLeaveSearchFilterParams used for filtering employee leave search results based on date and accessible employee numbers. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for date and accessible employee numbers, along with getter and setter methods. It also specifies allowed sorting fields for the search.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for employee on leave search filtering, includes date and accessible employee numbers with methods to set and get these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field 'employee.firstName'.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the array of accessible employee numbers or null.

methods.name: setAccessibleEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the array of accessible employee numbers.
